name: Niseko (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Niseko town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised mountain, with horizontal strokes at the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Niseko, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 May 1968.

features.role: Niseko town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised mountain, with horizontal strokes at the hoist
